learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how to thoughtfully review your own artwork, give helpful feedback to friends, and celebrate how much you have grown as an artist!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Evaluation is not about getting a test score. It is about looking at the drawings you made on day one and comparing them to what you can do now. It is a time to be proud of your progress!

When reviewing a friend's art, use the sandwich method! Start with something you love (the bread), suggest one gentle way to improve (the filling), and end with another positive compliment (the bottom bread).
A messy painting or a forgotten dance step is never a failure; it is just a stepping stone! Evaluating our mistakes helps us figure out exactly what to practice for next time.
A big part of evaluating art is learning to appreciate different styles. Even if a friend's art looks completely different from yours, you can still admire their unique creativity and hard work.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Art Critic Game
fun_activity.instructions: Find the very first drawing you made this year. Be your own friendly art critic: write down one thing you absolutely love about it, and one new skill you would use to make it even better today!

quick_recap: ⭐ Evaluation is a tool for seeing how much your artistic skills have grown over time.
⭐ Always give kind, helpful feedback that encourages others to keep practicing.
⭐ Mistakes in art are wonderful because they teach us how to improve.
⭐ Appreciating different types of art helps make you a better, more open-minded artist.
